about.intro: I'm a **Software Engineer** passionate about building **scalable backend systems**, **AI-powered applications**, and **modern software products**.
about.description: Building **scalable backend systems**, **AI-powered applications**, and **modern full-stack products** with a focus on clean architecture, performance and creating software that is **simple**, **reliable** and **impactful**.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Vallen Dsouza**, a **Software Engineer** and Computer Engineering graduate passionate about building **scalable software systems**, **AI-powered applications**, and products that solve real-world problems.

My journey into software development began during my Computer Engineering degree, where I was first introduced to programming. What started as curiosity quickly evolved into a passion for designing and building software that makes a meaningful impact. In **2023**, I began exploring full-stack web development with the MERN stack, laying the foundation for the engineering journey I'm on today.

Since then, I've built projects ranging from AI-powered SaaS platforms and developer tools to intelligent automation systems. Each project has strengthened my understanding of software architecture, clean code, scalability, and the complete product development lifecycle—from transforming ideas into production-ready applications.

Through internships in software engineering, machine learning, and data analysis, I've gained hands-on experience building production-ready software, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and understanding how reliable systems are designed, tested, and deployed in real-world environments.

Alongside software development, I have a strong passion for problem solving. I actively practice **Data Structures & Algorithms** in Java, have solved **900+ LeetCode problems**, earned the **LeetCode Knight** badge, and continue sharpening my skills through **Codeforces** and competitive programming. These experiences have strengthened my analytical thinking and taught me how to approach complex engineering challenges with confidence.

What excites me most is backend engineering—designing scalable architectures, building reliable APIs, optimizing databases, and integrating AI into products that people genuinely enjoy using. I believe great software isn't just about writing code; it's about building systems that remain **reliable**, **maintainable**, and **adaptable** as they evolve.

Beyond engineering, I enjoy exploring emerging technologies, participating in hackathons, experimenting with ambitious ideas, and continuously challenging myself through new projects. As a **2× Hackathon Winner**, I thrive in fast-paced environments where collaboration, creativity, and rapid problem solving come together to build meaningful solutions. Every experience teaches me something new, and that commitment to continuous learning is what drives me to grow as an engineer every day.

projects.title: Velora AI
projects.description: Velora AI is a multi-tenant AI customer support platform that enables businesses to deploy intelligent assistants capable of handling customer conversations with real-time AI-human escalation. Built with a scalable architecture using Next.js, Convex, Clerk, and AI integrations, it delivers secure authentication, contextual conversations, and production-ready customer support workflows.

projects.title: Hirely
projects.description: Hirely is an AI-powered interview preparation platform that helps students improve their placement readiness through resume analysis, job-specific interview generation, AI feedback, and personalized learning. It combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, and LLMs to deliver contextual interview experiences tailored to each candidate.

projects.title: PostBoy
projects.description: PostBoy is a modern API testing and collaboration platform designed for developers to test, organize, and share API workflows efficiently. It features AI-powered request generation, automatic API documentation, team workspaces, real-time collaboration, authentication, and PostgreSQL-backed data management, providing an end-to-end experience for modern API development.
